rows.label: tlk70000046_01_msg0001
rows.name: Oops... I'm out of pouch items.

rows.label: tlk70000046_01_msg0002
rows.name:
It's not like it's the end of the
world or anything, but they do make
life on the road a little easier.

rows.label: tlk70000046_01_msg0003
rows.name:
If you match their effects well, they
can be more reliable than a clumsy
person, and they last for hours.

rows.label: tlk70000046_01_msg0004
rows.name:
But... my work is almost done, so I
guess I'll get to finishing it.

rows.label: tlk70000046_01_msg0005
rows.name:
You should be loading up your pouches
with stuff as well. Just keep an
eye on how much you have left.
